verdict.rationale: Inngest is a headless backend workflow platform. It documents a terminal CLI that can inspect runs, fetch traces and invoke functions, a REST API for programmatic control of events and runs, self-hosting, and a Jest-compatible testing library suited to automated test pipelines. Together these clearly enable headless automation. Missing for 10: explicit CI integration docs (e.g. running the dev server or CLI in CI pipelines, CI auth or non-interactive flags), a published OpenAPI spec (probes 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
